name: servium-ia
description: Servium IA — monorepo (API NestJS + SPA React + tipos compartilhados)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @servium-ia/shared-types && npm run build -w @servium-ia/db && npm run build -w @servium-ia/api && npm run build -w @servium-ia/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @servium-ia/shared-types && npm run test -w @servium-ia/db && npm run test -w @servium-ia/api && npm run test -w @servium-ia/web && npm run test -w @servium-ia/runtime-e2e
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
